title: Productivity Brainwashing
description:
Productivity Brainwashing is a layered background conditioning file made to be listened to while you work.

Whether you’re studying, cleaning, writing, or chipping away at the endless pile of things you’ve been putting off, I’ll be there in the background lulling you into mindless compliance. The more you listen, the less you feel like questioning what you’re doing. You simply settle into it. Task after task, lost in the repetition of it all. This is a non erotic file contains a lot of praise and kisses for good behaviour, as well as directions to stay on task.

As always, this file is an erotic hypnosis fantasy and is best enjoyed with an understanding of subject agency. For more information on subject agency, MuttHypno has an excellent and comprehensive writing on Building Subject Agency
author: Lambellina
